comment: Deterministic per-frame budgets for `victus run --frames 120 --width 640 --height 360 --quality medium` (last frame). Each counter is [min, max]: max = measured + 10 % (at least +2), min = half the measured value for counters that prove the frame drew something. Fixed-frame runs use a fixed script seed, so counters repeat exactly between runs on one machine. frame_p95_ms_max is a coarse ceiling (about 5x the Debug lavapipe time on a 2-vCPU machine) that only catches catastrophic regressions. Measured 2026-11-18 on Ubuntu 26.04, Mesa lavapipe; sim.systems re-baselined 2026-11-19 at 27 (ragdoll pose, gameplay timers/attributes and water systems, ADR-0091/0094/0095); template-3d and template-multiplayer triangles, shadow triangles and buffer bytes re-baselined 2026-11-20 for the Orion/Nova starter characters (26.1k smooth-surface triangles replacing the 20.6k-triangle box robots, ADR-0121); template-3d and template-multiplayer shadow triangles re-baselined the same day at 23 180 and 15 459 for receiver-aware cascade culling (ADR-0124); sample-arena triangles, shadow triangles, entities and buffers re-baselined 2026-11-20 when the arena moved from the old box robot to Orion (player) and Nova (enemies); shadow triangles re-baselined the same day for per-cascade shadow LOD (ADR-0132): template-3d 23 180 to 19 094, template-multiplayer 15 459 to 14 457, sample-arena 28 328 to 24 178. sim.systems re-baselined 2026-11-21 at 31 after the simulation-LOD, vehicle and traffic work (ADR-0165-0167) registered more systems (min raised to half the count). See docs/PERFORMANCE_STRATEGY.md. Lightmapped templates (ADR-0134) re-baselined 2026-11-20: template-3d live buffers 60 and textures 22, template-multiplayer live buffers 53, textures 21 and main batches 13 (each lightmapped renderer owns its own atlas-space lightmap UV stream, so the arena's eight walls and pillars no longer instance together; per-instance lightmap scale/offset is the follow-up); the same day congruent lightmapped copies share one unwrap and batch again (ADR-0135): template-multiplayer main batches 13 to 9, live buffers 53 to 38. Re-baselined 2026-11-21 for the ADR-0179 human starter characters (60 joints, about 125k triangles, sixteen 2048 px PBR maps each as BC7/ASTC): triangles, shadow triangles, draw calls, batches, entities (the 60-joint node tree and eight sockets), buffers and textures for template-3d, template-multiplayer and sample-arena (template-3d texture bytes 29.1 MB to 141.8 MB with block compression, 490 MB without). Re-baselined 2026-11-21 for the ADR-0185 starter-character equipment (boots, gloves, belt and backpack: four more skinned nodes and a sixth 2048 px material per character, about 205k LOD 0 triangles): triangles, shadow triangles, draw calls, batches, visible, buffers and textures for template-3d, template-multiplayer and sample-arena. template-3d live textures re-baselined 2026-11-22 at 61 for the ADR-0197 HDR starter sky (budget 67); sample-arena live textures 66 and texture bytes 229.4 MB the same day for its starter materials and sky (nine uncompressed 1K maps).
